name: marketing-grader
description: Connect your Marketing Grader workspace to review saved brand content and marketing results with read-only MCP tools.

interface.shortDescription: Your brand content and results, together
interface.longDescription:
Marketing Grader is an AI marketing workspace for Hong Kong small businesses and marketing studios. Organise brand DNA and product information, prepare social copy and branded posters, plan content, work on SEO articles and email content, and review recorded marketing performance. Website integrations depend on the relevant platform permissions and availability.

This MCP connection provides nine read-only tools for your own brands: saved DNA, drafts, calendar, social connection status, post results, advertising strategy, and explicitly granted Search Console/GA4 snapshots. It cannot save drafts, generate images, publish posts, send email, export contact lists, modify websites or ads, spend money or process payments. Google reports are saved snapshots, not live refreshes. Missing results remain unknown.
defaultPrompt: List my available brands, then ask which one to use.
For my selected brand, summarize scheduled social drafts and SEO plans. Keep plans separate from published posts.
Compare saved 24-hour and seven-day post results. Show missing data as unknown and include timestamps.
